full_name: Crude Flow Terminal - Autonomous AI Driven Crude Oil Market Analyzer
purpose: Real-time crude oil market analysis, trading signals, and backtesting platform using quantitative analytics, technical indicators, and fundamental data (inventory, COT positioning, spreads, volatility)
deployment: Streamlit web app (http://localhost:8501) + DuckDB columnar database + Docker containerization

core_files.name: app.py
core_files.role: Streamlit main entry point / UI orchestrator
responsibilities: Multi-page navigation (Predictive Terminal, Quant Analysis, Volume Profile, Data Ingestion, Data Explorer)
Dataset loading orchestration (WTI, Brent-Spread, COT, EIA/API stocks, OVX, RBOB, Heating Oil)

core_files.name: ui_components.py
core_files.role: UI rendering hub - all visual pages
responsibilities: render_terminal_page() - Core predictive dashboard (quant metrics, force matrix, alerts)
render_quant_page() - Detailed technical analysis (liquidity sweeps, VWAP, RSI, S&R)
render_volume_profile_page() - Volume profile analysis & trade signals
Calls data_engine, quant_engine, and strategy functions to compute & display metrics

core_files.name: quant_engine.py
functions: calculate_crack_spreads() - Refining spreads (2*RBOB + 1*HO - 3*WTI)
calculate_z_score() - Normalize WTI-Brent spread against historical mean/std
detect_liquidity_sweeps_v2() - Identify breakouts with volume confirmation (>1.5x avg vol)
calculate_inventory_shock() - EIA/API actual vs forecast difference (in barrels)
calculate_inv_momentum() - 4-week MA of inventory changes (structural draw indicator)
calculate_rsi() - 14-period Relative Strength Index
calculate_vwap() - 20-period Volume-Weighted Avg Price
calculate_sr_levels() - Support/Resistance within 10-period window
generate_convergence_verdict() - Consensus signal from multiple indicators (z-score, COT, inventory, price overextension)
generate_detailed_force_matrix() - Multi-factor risk/reward matrix with weighted scores
calculate_volume_profile() - VWAP-based volume distribution analysis
calculate_realized_volatility() - 30-period rolling volatility from price returns
calculate_vol_premium() - OVX vs implied volatility comparison

core_files.name: strategy.py
functions: build_volume_profile() - Bin prices by volume distribution
calculate_poc() - Point of Control (highest volume price)
calculate_value_area() - 70% of volume price range
detect_hvn_lvn() - High/Low Volume Node detection
detect_volume_gaps() - Price levels with no volume (resistance/support)
calculate_volume_profile_signals() - Orchestrator combining all VP analysis
generate_vp_signals() - Entry/exit rules from VP structure
calculate_vp_targets_sl() - TP/SL levels from POC, value area, HVN/LVN

core_files.name: data_engine.py
functions: normalize_columns() - Standardize column names across tables
clean_volume() - Handle missing/zero volume values
validate_df() - Schema enforcement (date, price, vol, etc)
generate_row_hash() - Upsert detection (avoid duplicates)
upsert_to_duckdb() - Idempotent writes to DuckDB tables
load_from_db() - Query helper for retrieving datasets

core_files.name: config.py
content: REQUIRED_SCHEMAS: 8 tables (wti_ohlc, wti_brent_spread, api_stocks, eia_stocks, cot_data, gasoline_rbob, heating_oil, ovx_data)
DATA_SOURCES: URLs to public data (Investing.com, CFTC, etc)
WEIGHTS: Scoring multipliers (crack_spread:2x, z_score:3x, cot_squeeze:3x, inv_surprise:2x, inv_momentum:2x, price_overext:-2x)

core_files.name: backtester.py
responsibilities: load_historical_data() - Multi-table historical queries from DuckDB
calculate_daily_signals() - Compute all metrics for each backtest date
run_backtest() - Walk-forward simulation with P&L tracking
print_backtest_results() - Summary statistics (Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, etc)

data_flow.step_1_ingest: CSV upload → data_engine (validate, normalize, deduplicate) → upsert_to_duckdb (crude_flow.db)
data_flow.step_2_load: app.py / backtester.py queries DuckDB for (WTI, Brent-Spread, COT, EIA/API, OVX, RBOB, HO)
data_flow.step_3_compute: quant_engine computes cracks, z-scores, inventory metrics, technical indicators; strategy computes volume profiles
data_flow.step_5_render: ui_components.render_* pages display metrics, charts, alerts, and VP-based trade targets/stops
data_flow.step_6_backtest: backtester.py replays all dates, accumulates P&L, reports Sharpe/drawdown/win-rate

key_metrics_produced: Inventory Momentum (4-week MA of stock changes)
Volume Profile (POC, Value Area, HVN/LVN, Gaps)

ui_components.py::render_terminal_page.produces: Force matrix, alerts, fundamental metrics display

ui_components.py::render_volume_profile_.produces: VP visualization, entry/exit rules, TP/SL levels

predictive_terminal: app.py → ui_components.render_terminal_page() → quant_engine (inventory, z-score, RSI, force matrix) → UI
Outputs: BUY/SELL signal, risk/reward matrix, alerts
volume_profile_trading: app.py → ui_components.render_volume_profile_page() → strategy (VP, POC, value area, HVN/LVN) → trade signals + targets/stops
backtest: backtester.py → load_historical_data() → walk-forward daily signals → quant_engine + strategy → P&L accumulation → performance stats
Outputs: Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, cumulative return

separation_of_concerns: strategy.py: Pure math (volume analysis, signal generation)
statefulness: Streamlit session state manages page-level UI state
No inter-function state passed (except DataFrames via return values)
scaling_bottlenecks: DuckDB query performance on large datasets (>1M rows)
Quant computations (rolling window calculations) may be CPU-bound for backtests
Volume profile binning resolution could impact memory for high-frequency data
